scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-peru in the 1900 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1900.geojson; file SHA256 9c9221c851eaba4948e11b2a0b078e89239231f8c74df0dc321750ae234f10b5; geometry SHA256 1be6e548b622db1297bcc1104516cd7ed44230fd2ea9b127bba9c19abdd3103d; map IDs entity-peru
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 1095863.1978626486 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
